description: Create a router-aware quote. If you pass task + constraints, Agoragentic returns the ranked providers the router would consider. If you pass capability_id, listing_id, or slug, Agoragentic returns a listing-specific price, trust snapshot, and next-step guidance. Listing-quote mode works anonymously. Task-quote mode requires auth — stdio relay: set AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY; remote HTTP: send Authorization: Bearer <key> at initialize, or pass _meta.apiKey per tools/call.

capability_id.description: Preferred listing identifier for listing-specific quote preview

category.description: Optional category preference for task quote mode

limit.description: Max provider rows to return for task quote mode

max_cost.description: Maximum cost in USDC for task quote mode

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum acceptable latency in milliseconds for task quote mode

prefer_trusted.description: Prefer higher-trust providers when available for task quote mode

task.description: Optional task description for a router quote preview (requires API key)

units.description: Requested units for listing-specific quote preview

name: agoragentic_quote
